profile.description: Update your personal information and preferences.

profile.outreachPagesDescription: Show the Inbox, Prospects and Cadence pages in the nav bar.
profile.servicePagesDescription: Show these service pages in the nav bar and on Home. Hidden by default.
profile.landingPageDescription: The page that opens first when you log in.
profile.personalInfoDescription: Your name and how to reach you.

preferences.timezoneDescription: Used for dates, times and scheduling.
preferences.appearanceDescription: Theme and language for this device.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Choose how and when you receive notifications.

telegram.title: Telegram Notifications
telegram.setupHint: Tap the link below to open the bot. It will reply with your Chat ID. Paste it here.

push.title: Browser Push Notifications
push.notSupported: Push notifications are not supported in this browser.
push.permissionDenied: Notifications are blocked. Please allow them in your browser settings.
push.notConfigured: Push notifications are not configured on this server.
push.serverRegistrationFailed: Could not register, please try again.

hub.themeDesc: Switch between light and dark mode

gmail.title: Email Integration
gmail.description: Connect your Gmail account to send and receive emails directly from the CRM.

security.title: Security
security.description: Manage your password and account security.
security.passwordUpdated: Your password has been updated successfully.
security.checkInbox: Check your inbox for a password reset link.
security.resetNotAvailable: Password reset via email is not yet available.
security.minLength: New password must be at least 6 characters.
security.passwordsMismatch: New password and confirmation do not match.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Add a second step at sign-in so a stolen password is not enough.
twoFactor.requiredNow: Two-factor authentication is now required. Set up a method below to keep using the app.
twoFactor.requiredSoon: Two-factor authentication is required for your account. Set it up within {{count}} days.

totp.title: Authenticator app
totp.description: A 6-digit code from an app like Google Authenticator, 1Password or Authy.
totp.scanHelp: Open your authenticator app, add an account and scan the code. Then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
totp.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key by hand:

email.title: Email code
email.description: We email you a 6-digit code at sign-in. Also your way back in if you lose your phone.
email.setupHelp: We send a code to your account email now. This also proves your inbox works, which matters because email is the recovery route.

passkey.title: Passkeys
passkey.description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or device PIN. No code to type.
passkey.addHelp: Your browser will ask you to confirm with this device.
passkey.failed: The passkey could not be added.

backup.title: Backup codes
backup.none: No codes yet. Keep them somewhere safe in case you lose your phone.
backup.low: Only {{count}} left. Make new ones soon.
backup.generateHelp: You get 10 one-time codes. Making new codes cancels the old ones.
backup.showOnce: Save these now. They are shown only once, and each works one time.

devices.title: Trusted devices
devices.description: Browsers that skip the second step for 30 days.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.help: To remove a method, enter your password and a code.

twoFactorPolicy.title: Require two-factor authentication
twoFactorPolicy.description: Owner only. Force users to set up a second step, with time to do it.

modeHelp.off: Nobody is forced. Users can still turn it on themselves.
modeHelp.admins: Owners and Admins must set it up.
modeHelp.everyone: Every user must set it up.

twoFactorPolicy.perAccountHelp: Override the default for one account. After the grace period, users without a method can only reach Settings.

twoFactorReset.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactorReset.confirm: This removes every 2FA method for {{name}} and signs them out. Check it is really them first, for example on a call.

securityLog.title: Security log
securityLog.description: Sign-ins, second-factor checks and changes to protection. Kept for 180 days.
